newsitem.title: CHINA: Mitsubishi Heavy in $164 mln China deal.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Heavy in $164 mln China deal.

text.p: China said on Wednesday it had signed a contract with Mitsubishi Heavy Industries of Japan to buy $164 million worth of equipment for a power plant in northern Shanxi province.

The China National Technical Import and Export Corp had signed the deal to buy boilers, turbine generators and other equipment for the Shanxi Hejin Power Generation Co Ltd, the official Xinhua news agency said.
The Mitsubishi Corp was also a partner to the deal, Xinhua said but gave no further details. It did not say when the contract was signed.
Mitsubishi Heavy said in January it had won an order to supply two power generators for a coal-burning power plant in Shanxi.
